candidates.name: Plumefist
candidates.lore: Too heavy to fly and too proud to hide. It settles every dispute with its talons, and it looks for disputes.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Pyrelord
candidates.lore: The mountain's first king and its only one. Every eruption since has been his voice.

candidates.name: Hollowplate
candidates.lore: The knight left long ago. The armor kept the vigil, and the fire that keeps it standing has forgotten whose it was.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Pebblet
candidates.lore: A pebble that pinches. The beach is full of stones, and some of them are waiting.

candidates.name: Marrowbolt
candidates.lore: It cannot see and does not miss. The arrows are older than the bow, and the bow is older than the wall.

candidates.name: Scaleblade
candidates.lore: Its people ruled the marsh before the marsh drowned them. It still patrols the borders of a country that is gone.

candidates.name: Moonrend
candidates.lore: It runs the ridge under every full moon and comes back fed. The village no longer asks what it ate.

candidates.name: Stonewing
candidates.lore: It kept watch from the chapel eaves for centuries. When the last bell fell silent, it came down.

candidates.name: Stonegaze
candidates.lore: Meet its eyes and become a landmark. The roadside is lined with people who did, still pointing the way.

candidates.name: Magmatoad
candidates.lore: It basks in the lava as other toads bask on stone. Its croak carries sulphur and its bite carries fire.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Wrapwarden
candidates.lore: Its name was carved off the tomb, so it went looking for it. It checks every face and none of them fit.

candidates.name: Hoodfang
candidates.lore: It sways so you will watch the hood. The bite comes from where you were not watching.

candidates.name: Foxfire
candidates.lore: Three tails, three lies, and one truth it will tell you for a price you will not like.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Glareling
candidates.lore: It watches for something bigger. What it sees, the something bigger sees too.

candidates.name: Pebblemite
candidates.lore: It is a pebble until it isn't. Cairns are made of them, and cairns move at night.

candidates.name: Broodmother
candidates.lore: Every spider in the dark is hers and every dark is a nursery. She does not hunt; she waits, and the dark brings supper.

candidates.name: Prismfather
candidates.lore: Light goes into it and comes out wrong. Miners follow the rainbows down and are found as rainbows themselves.

candidates.name: Dapplekin
candidates.lore: Born where the old stag fell. The forest watches over it, and takes offence on its behalf.

candidates.name: Cinderkit
candidates.lore: A fox born in the ash beds. It is warm to the touch and will not be held.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Stiltwing
candidates.lore: It stands in the reeds for hours without a breath. Whatever moves beneath the water is already chosen.

candidates.name: Shellet
candidates.lore: The first of the clutch to reach the water, and the only one. It has been careful ever since.

candidates.name: Dunekit
candidates.lore: Grown cats of the dunes wear the sun as armour. This one has not yet, and hides from it in the noon shade.

candidates.name: Rimeling
candidates.lore: A splinter of the glacier that walks ahead of the cold. Where it stands, the frost arrives early.

graduation.blocking: HIS pick, two full takes — attack: attack_v1, attack_v3

candidates.name: Ashling
candidates.lore: Hatched in the cinder beds beneath the caldera. It will grow into a mouthful of flame; for now it only glows.

candidates.name: Deepclaw
candidates.lore: It has never seen the sun and hunts without needing to. In the deep galleries it smells a torch before the torch is lit.

candidates.name: Carrionwing
candidates.lore: It circles the road for days and lands only when it is certain. It has never once been wrong.

candidates.name: Gulo
candidates.lore: Small enough to be mistaken for prey and strong enough to drive a bear off a kill. It has done both.

candidates.name: Frostyak
candidates.lore: It crosses the high passes in weather that kills men. The herds are gone; this one still walks the route alone.

candidates.name: Warmaul
candidates.lore: It fights for whoever pays in iron and eats whoever does not. The axe has a name; it will not say it.

candidates.name: Duskplate
candidates.lore: He kept his oath after his lord broke it, and now the oath is all that is left of him.

candidates.name: Coilblade
candidates.lore: The temple in the swamp is hers and the swamp is the temple. Every stone step is guarded, and she is the steps.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Hornmaul
candidates.lore: The maze was built around it, not for it. It knows every turn, and it is always one turn behind you.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Tollkeeper
candidates.lore: The bridge is older than the town and the troll is older than the bridge. The toll has never once been coin.

candidates.name: Blackhorn
candidates.lore: The last of the wild herd, and it knows it. It charges anything that crosses the meadow, and the meadow is wide.

candidates.name: Sandsting
candidates.lore: It hides in boots and bedrolls. The sting is small; the fever it brings is not.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Palewick
candidates.lore: It was carried into the mine and came back alone. The light it gives leads only one way.

candidates.name: Grimimp
candidates.lore: The gargoyles' lesser kin, cut from the same stone. It sits in the eaves and drops on whatever passes beneath.

candidates.name: Pitjaw
candidates.lore: It digs the pit and lies beneath the floor of it. The sand slides, and whatever stood on the slope goes down to the jaws.

candidates.name: Cragram
candidates.lore: It holds the high ledge against anything that climbs. The horns have broken shields, and the mountain has never won.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Burrkin
candidates.lore: It catches on everything that passes and keeps a thread of it. None of it is worth anything and it will not put any of it down.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Briarknot
candidates.lore: The nest was left before the bramble grew around it. It keeps the eggs warm out of habit and there is nothing inside them.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Urchling
candidates.lore: The tide put it down and went away without it. It has been walking inland ever since, very slowly.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Helmcrab
candidates.lore: It chose the helmet for the fit, not the history. Something else wore it out of the sea.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Driftbone
candidates.lore: Everything the sea gave back, standing in the order it washed up. It does not go near the water.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Whelkspire
candidates.lore: It drills the shell of anything slower than itself, which is most things. It takes a whole day and it does not hurry.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Peatling
candidates.lore: Cut out of the bank and never carried away. It puts itself back every time the water takes a piece.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Turfstack
candidates.lore: Stacked to dry by somebody who meant to come back for it. It has done its own drying and it is ready to be burned.

candidates.name: Mudnewt
candidates.lore: It breathes the bog through its gills and the bog has been breathing back. It is bigger every year.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Pitchergut
candidates.lore: It drinks whatever falls in, and it has learned what falls in most. It leans toward warmth.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Withyman
candidates.lore: Woven around nothing, on purpose, by somebody. It is the one thing here that was built rather than left.

candidates.name: Quagmaw
candidates.lore: The ground opens where it walks and closes behind it. What it takes goes down further than the bog does.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Screeback
candidates.lore: The slope it came off is still missing a piece. It rebuilds itself out of whatever is underfoot.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Flintjaw
candidates.lore: Somebody knapped a tool out of its face a long time ago. The edges it has now, it made itself.

candidates.name: Platecurl
candidates.lore: It uncoils only to move and only to eat. Stone dust is most of its diet and it has worn grooves in the road.

candidates.name: Quernjaw
candidates.lore: It ground for a household that is not there. It goes on turning and it is not particular about what goes in.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Boneshale
candidates.lore: It was a shape before this was stone. The stone is the only part of it that is still here.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Rockface
candidates.lore: Somebody cut a face into it to be looked at by. Only the face moves, the rest is still a rock.

candidates.name: Snowgrouse
candidates.lore: It is white all winter and it does not know when winter ends here. It breaks cover at the last possible moment.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Snowlip
candidates.lore: It is the piece of the ridge that was about to fall. It has been about to fall for a long time now.

candidates.name: Rimebeard
candidates.lore: It grew out of one night of cold on something that was already dead. Warm breath takes pieces off it.

candidates.name: Thawborn
candidates.lore: The thaw gives back what the snow was keeping, in one piece, walking. It comes down the mountain every year.

candidates.name: Moraine
candidates.lore: The ice pushed it ahead of itself for a thousand years and then let go. It is still going in the same direction.

candidates.name: Icefall
candidates.lore: The water inside it never stopped. It is the loudest thing on the mountain and it only speaks in thaw.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Pumicekin
candidates.lore: It came out of the mountain in the air, not the ground. It weighs almost nothing and it is nearly impossible to catch.

candidates.name: Basaltkin
candidates.lore: It cooled into these shapes on its own, in straight lines, without being cut. The mountain does this and nobody knows why it is neat.

candidates.name: Ashfall
candidates.lore: It settled over everything that was there in one afternoon. The prints in it are not of anything that is still here.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Cindermask
candidates.lore: It burned and kept the shape it burned in. Pieces come off it and it does not notice.

candidates.name: Riftmaw
candidates.lore: The mountain opened here and the opening walked away. The crack in it has never closed and never widened.

candidates.name: Whitegill
candidates.lore: It has never needed eyes and it does not have them. It knows the shape of the water it is in perfectly.

candidates.name: Moonmilk
candidates.lore: It takes a print from anything that touches it and keeps it. Some of the prints on it are very small.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Sinterstep
candidates.lore: Warm water built it a step at a time on its way down. The pools on it are still the right temperature.

candidates.name: Goodguest
candidates.lore: It steps aside to let you go first, every time. Hearn said it asked politely, and he is the only one who came back up.

candidates.name: Facewall
candidates.lore: The faces come further out the longer you look at it. None of them are finished and all of them are the same one.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Thinning
candidates.lore: It is most of the way to the Quiet and it has stopped going. Standing near it is cold in a way that is not temperature.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Listener
candidates.lore: It has no face because it is not for being looked at. It leans in when you speak and it does not miss anything.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Holemaw
candidates.lore: The hole under the mountain, standing up. It is new, and the oldest here say the worst part is who it has to be.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: idle, walk, angry, attack, die
